data.rationale: The proposed spec matches the true workflow step for step, in the same order and with the same parameters: click Restaurants, type the location and pick the suggestion, optionally expand the filters, click the filter label, then apply. Every step is concrete and both changing inputs are named as parameters, so a browser automation could be built from it.
